name: ledgerpress
description: One academic record, published as a website and PDF CV.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-cv-data.mjs && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: echo "Regenerating cv/generated/cv-data.tex from content/cv.yaml — this check writes that tracked file." && npm run build:cv-data && npm test && npm --prefix web run check && npm --prefix web run build && npm run check:deployment-base && npm run check:adopter && npm run check:format
scripts.check:maintainer: bash scripts/check-cv-baseline.sh && bash scripts/check-cv-baseline.sh cv/short.pdf && bash scripts/check-cv-baseline.sh cv/teaching.pdf
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && node --test scripts/build-cv-data.test.mjs && node --test scripts/import-orcid.test.mjs && node scripts/build-cv-data.mjs --check
